description: Assignment: an order that fits Own fleet on its collection day. Own fleet is the first choice when it Fits, because Norvia has already paid for its Vehicles and Drivers. Known answer: assign-own-fleet, with no capacity warning.

setup.seed: Book a Transport Order as Brouwer Dranken from Rotterdam to Utrecht (6 pallets, 1800 kg) in the Partner portal and leave it unassigned, collecting on a weekday the Capacity view shows open with room for it (not the Over capacity demo day that infra/smoke-test-over-capacity-day.ps1 prints (P10)). Set EVALUATION_SUBJECT to the Transport Order's number.

input: Suggest who should carry the Transport Order ${EVALUATION_SUBJECT}, with the reasoning and the trade-off against the other options.

explanation.rubric: Recommends Own fleet because it fits the collection day, says why in a sentence and names no capacity warning. Quotes any Carrier cost only as the result gives it.
